content.text:
Remove the `blockTags` array from [docs/typedoc.json](docs/typedoc.json). TypeDoc treats the inherited [tsdoc.json](tsdoc.json) configuration as authoritative, so defining tags in both places causes the warning.

I made that change and reran:

```sh
cd docs && node scripts/build-api-en.ts
```

The API build completed cleanly with no TypeDoc warnings.
